projects.name: ReactivePipe
projects.blurb: Pipeline-parallel inference that adapts when co-located workloads interfere.
details: Static pipeline parallelism splits a model across processes once and assumes the hardware stays quiet. On shared machines, co-located workloads slow individual stages, and the slowest stage sets the pace for the whole pipeline.

ReactivePipe re-partitions the model across processes when interference appears, keeping 70–87% of its throughput where static pipelines lose half. It was my Master's dissertation and is to appear as a workshop paper at Euro-Par 2026.

projects.name: uxn-on-gpu
projects.blurb: The Uxn virtual machine, executing directly in GPU kernels.
details: Uxn is a small stack-based virtual machine. This project explores running VM execution directly on the GPU, with the interpreter written as Vulkan compute kernels compiled to SPIR-V.

projects.name: llm-discord-bot
projects.blurb: Discord chatbot running local LLM inference through Ollama.
details: A Discord chatbot backed by a local model through Ollama, so nothing leaves the machine.
It recalls earlier conversations through semantic memory built on embeddings, and keeps probabilistic summaries of the people it talks to.
